R2Orch.fit: Training task selection and orchestration when repeated controlled rollouts are available.
R2Orch.limit: A single task score does not establish recursive learnability or successful skill internalization.
R2Orch.mechanism: Inner orchestration self-play and outer skill withdrawal/internalization guided by recursive learnability.

RSIGym.fit: Experiments spanning data, model and harness interventions.
RSIGym.limit: Service availability and budget accounting remain part of reproducibility.
RSIGym.mechanism: Service-based training, inference, evaluation and sandboxes with shared budgets and permissions.

Terminal-RSI.fit: Training terminal agents with verifier and partial-progress signals.
Terminal-RSI.limit: Not merely a terminal sandbox; requires model/critic training infrastructure not reproduced here.
Terminal-RSI.mechanism: Alternating verified trajectory rewriting and critic-inheriting policy refinement, with turn-aware advantage estimation.
